response.overview: In 1984, I created a video piece set to "Anything Goes," the opening theme of "Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom." The theme was how familiar movements would change through film editing, and I made it in a relaxed manner. Now, in 2026, I've restored the footage and re-edited it (since I can't use the "Anything Goes" song) with GarageBand dubbing. The original was on 8mm film, so some of the film's characteristic screen shake, scratches, and dust remain. Enjoy the Showa era!
response.title: Anything Goes
